notes:
Shirley Madill, Executive Director, Kitchener Waterloo Art Gallery gave a presentation updating Council on the activities of the Art Gallery, noting 2026 is the 70th anniversary of the Kitchener Waterloo Art Gallery. items.title: DELEGATIONS
Official Plan Amendment Application OPA24/011/C/AP, Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA24/023/C/AP, 808-836 Courtland Avenue East, 808 Courtland GP Inc., DSD-2025-002, listed as item 7.4.b
notes:
Council considered Official Plan Amendment Application OPA24/011/C/AP, Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA24/023/C/AP, 808-836 Courtland Avenue East, 808 Courtland GP Inc., DSD-2025-002, listed as item 7.4.b on the agenda this date. In addition, Council was in receipt of a written submission from Dentons Canada LLP on behalf of CN Rail, Graham and Christine Lehman and Lisa Worboys. Garett Stevenson, Director, Development and Housing Approvals was in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

Kevin Muir, Zehr Group, was in attendance in support of the subject application and to respond to questions of Council if required.

Lisa Worboys addressed Council in opposition of the subject application, expressing concerns with the proposed development and the potential adverse impacts on traffic safety as a result of the proposed development.

In response to questions from Council, G. Stevenson advised that staff are recommending that a Holding "H" Provision be added to the recommendation, until such a time that the accurate water capacity for this development is required prior to building permit issuance. G. Stevenson then responded questions regarding the lifting of holding provisions delegated to staff and noted that the removal of the H provision rests with Council, when satisfied by the Region that the provision can be lifted. G. Stevenson then addressed planning mechanisms to remove the provision. 

A motion was brought forward by Councillor J. Deneault, which was seconded by Councillor D. Chapman, to approve the recommendation as presented by Planning Staff this date.

items.title: Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA25/026/W/EW, 7 Wimbleton Crescent, DSD-2026-001, listed as item 7.4.
notes:
Council considered Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA25/026/W/EW, 7 Wimbleton Crescent, DSD-2026-001, listed as item 7.4. Garett Stevenson, Director, Development and Housing Approvals was in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

David Galbraith, Up Consulting, was in attendance on behalf of the applicant, noting support for the staff recommendation, clarified building height of 9.8m, and to respond to questions from Council regarding capping building height at 10m.

In response to questions from Council, G. Stevenson provided an alternative recommendation that Council could consider, which included Holding "H" Provision that would address the concerns of the Region of Waterloo, related to water capacity; and, a provision that would restrict the building height to a maximum of 10m as requested by Council at the Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee meeting. 

Councillor S. Davey brought forward the alternative recommendation as suggested by staff, including the Holding Provision and height restriction, which was seconded by Councillor D. Chapman.
